128.literal: The hell—just who are you, anyway?
128.official: Just who the hell ARE you?

129.literal: H-huh... So you were one of the real deal (an actual yakuza)...?!
129.official: Whoa, wait, you're a proper yakuza!?

130.literal: We're—no, I mean, we're with Toko Credit.
130.official: We just work for Toko Credit.

131.literal: Toko Credit, huh... That works out nicely.

132.literal: In that case, I'd think he's at the office right now.
132.official: The president? I figure he'd be at the office at this hour.

133.official: And that takes care of that little debt of ours, right?

134.literal: That's the rule of debt collection (kiritori).
134.official: That's how our kinda debt collection works.

135.literal: Ho ho ho, the world of competition is a harsh one, eh...

136.literal: What's your aim in getting close to me?
136.official: Why approach me? What are you after?

137.literal: If there's some reason behind it, tell me the whole story.
137.official: Look, if you're in some trouble, tell me.

138.literal: ...The same goes for that guy called Kamoji.
138.official: And that goes for him, too.

139.literal: For just a homeless guy, his movements aren't those of an amateur.
139.official: Those weren't the moves of an amateur.

140.literal: ...Sounds like some shady line of work.

141.literal: That's not it! It's 'Try-and-Knock-Me-Down' guy... that's what it is.

142.literal: We take a participation fee from the customers, and...

143.literal: He's got loads of essence (raw talent)!
143.official: Kamoji-kun here's got plenty to teach you about fighting, my boy.

144.literal: You'd be missing out if you don't watch, boy!
144.official: You'll kick yourself if you don't check it out.

145.literal: Shichifuku Park, right? I'll head over when I get the time.
145.official: Shichifuku Parking Lot, right? I'll swing by if I can find the time.

146.literal: Well now, one matter's been settled, but...
146.official: Well, that takes care of my troubles for today...

147.literal: Don't tell me you're trying to say I should become a martial artist?
147.official: Are you still trying to recruit me into pro fighting or whatever it was?

148.literal: ...Well, coming from someone I've only just met,

149.literal: But for me right now, above all else,

150.literal: Try not to get stabbed to death by a knife, eh!

151.literal: Also, getting shot with a gun is dangerous too, y'know!

152.literal: Don't go saying such ominous things.

154.literal: (Guess I'll go find a payphone and try calling back.)

155.literal: (Nishiki should be bringing the car around.)

158.literal: I'm gonna go call the office.

160.literal: You're being called in over that news just now, right?
160.official: It's gotta be about what they were saying on the news, right?

161.literal: This has turned into a real mess.

162.literal: No, you're obviously in deep trouble too, of course, but...
162.official: You're obviously screwed, but this also paints a giant target on Kazama-san's back.

163.literal: The fact that you and I were taken in by the boss means...
163.official: Everybody in the Dojima Family knows it was Kazama-san who brought us in.

165.literal: ...end up being the boss's responsibility too.

166.literal: Probably, the guys angling to take the boss's place...
166.official: Everybody with an eye on his position is going to come at this with everything they've got.

167.literal: Like the three Dojima Family lieutenants, for instance.
167.official: The three Dojima lieutenants, for starters.

168.literal: Word is he was sold out by one of those three.
168.official: Rumor has it, it was one of them that sold Kazama-san out to the cops and got him pinched six months back.

169.literal: You mean they sold him out to the cops?
169.official: You really think Kuze sold Kazama-san out to the cops?

170.literal: Of course, it's not like I've got proof.
170.official: Well, it's not like I've got hard proof.

171.literal: Kuze's really on a roll. And, well, where there's no smoke without fire...
171.official: But you know Kuze's been on a power trip ever since the old man got locked up. And where there's smoke...

173.literal: I'll try to find someone who can lend me their wits.

174.literal: (Since I don't know what they're plotting,)
174.official: (I don't know what they're up to...)

175.literal: (it can't hurt to be on my guard, but...)

176.literal: (I'd better get myself properly prepared first.)
176.official: (No telling what's waiting in there. I need to be ready.)

177.literal: I-I can't believe it. No way you actually made it this far...
177.official: N-No way... How'd you make it here!?

178.literal: I'm gonna have you tell me everything, nice and slow.
178.official: Now we can talk without any interruptions.

179.literal: ...Why did you set me up? What's your aim?
179.official: Why did you set me up? What are you after?

180.literal: (I was told) to have you do the collection at that spot...
180.official: He said I should have you collect the cash there in that back lot...

181.literal: I told you to turn yourself in to the cops, didn't I.
181.official: Pretty sure I told you to turn yourself in,

182.official: and instead you're over here doing dumb shit!

183.literal: Ah, yeah, I really am a little rusty...
183.official: Damn, I knew I was getting soft.

184.literal: Mr. President, could you give us a moment alone?
184.official: Mr. President, think I could get a little privacy?

185.literal: Good opportunity, this... With you, just once,
185.official: I'm glad we have this opportunity.

186.literal: I'd been wanting to have a real heart-to-heart with you.
186.official: I wanted to have a chat with you. No bullshit.

187.literal: You and Nishikiyama... you're orphans, I hear?
187.official: You and Nishikiyama... You're orphans, right?

188.literal: You came out of the facility that Kazama the lieutenant runs, right?
188.official: Grew up in Kazama's joint. Sunflower Orphanage, wasn't it?

189.literal: There's no need to feel ashamed just because you're an orphan.
189.official: There's no shame in being an orphan.

190.literal: And now you've turned into a fine little bullet-shield for him, haven't you—
190.official: He's got you and your boy Nishikiyama acting like human shields for him.

191.literal: This kind of thing—is that what they call brainwashing?
191.official: That's some brainwashing kind of shit right there.
